bead.title: bench-pr-A1b: shell harness-adapters (8) + harness-adapters listing + CONTRACT
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The matrix-side harness IO contract is Python (scripts/benchmark/harness_adapters/*.py), so the bash runner (A2/A3) cannot translate a profile into a harness install/command without Python. Each harness must be re-expressed as a self-describing shell adapter with install/command subcommands, and the harbor_plugin import path the Go runner hardwires must instead be emitted by these adapters.

ROOT CAUSE: cmd/bench/matrix.go harborAgentArgs (~lines 1014-1026) hardwires `--agent-import-path scripts.benchmark.harbor_adapters.<x>` per harness (claude:ClaudeAgent, codex:CodexAgent, opencode:OpencodeAgent, pi:PiAgent; default fiz -> harbor_agent:FizeauAgent). The only IO contract is Python: scripts/benchmark/harness_adapters/{fiz,opencode,pi,cost_probe,noop,dumb_script}.py, with harbor classes at scripts/benchmark/harbor_agent.py:83 (FizeauAgent) and scripts/benchmark/harbor_adapters/{claude.py:31,codex.py:32,opencode.py:64,pi.py:68}.

PROPOSED FIX:
- scripts/benchmark/harness-adapters/{fiz,claude,codex,opencode,pi,cost-probe,noop,dumb-script}: each executable, with a '# SUMMARY:' header and two subcommands: `install <agent-artifact-path>` -> install-spec.json {install_command, artifact_source, binary_path, harbor_plugin}; `command` (profile JSON on stdin) -> command-spec.json {command, env, secret_env_keys}. claude/codex emit harbor_plugin scripts.benchmark.harbor_adapters.{claude:ClaudeAgent,codex:CodexAgent}; fiz emits scripts.benchmark.harbor_agent:FizeauAgent. The Python harness_adapters/*.py are the reference for emitted shapes; shared helpers in scripts/benchmark/harness-adapters/common.sh.
- ./benchmark harness-adapters: list every harness adapter with its '# SUMMARY:' line.
- scripts/benchmark/harness-adapters/CONTRACT.md: document install-spec.json / command-spec.json shapes and the '# SUMMARY:' convention.

NON-SCOPE: harbor-runner Docker image + build script (sibling A1a); task-executors/harbor wrapper + its listing/contract (sibling A1c); runtime-probe.sh (sibling A1d); runner dispatch/--plan/matrix expansion (A2); per-cell execution loop, resume/retry, report compose (A3); concurrency/signals/budget (A4); Go changes, deactivation, parity (A5); cell-report.schema.json (PR B); tasks_from/task_executor bench-set schema (PR C); Node collector (PR D); Node importers (PR E); deleting cmd/bench (PR F); docs (PR G).

DEPENDENCY: parent fizeau-163efede. No sibling deps — spec emission, listing, and contract tests need neither the runner image nor Docker. Governing artifact: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

ACCEPTANCE:
1. ./benchmark harness-adapters lists every harness adapter with its '# SUMMARY:' line. Test: Test_AdapterListing_Harness (scripts/benchmark/tests/adapters.bats).
2. echo <profile.json> | harness-adapters/fiz command emits command-spec.json matching scripts/benchmark/harness_adapters/fiz.py. Test: Test_AdapterContract_fiz (scripts/benchmark/tests/adapters.bats).
3. harness-adapters/<x> install emits install-spec.json with the correct harbor_plugin for all 8 (claude->...claude:ClaudeAgent, codex->...codex:CodexAgent, fiz->harbor_agent:FizeauAgent, etc.). Test: Test_AdapterContract_claude, Test_AdapterContract_codex (scripts/benchmark/tests/adapters.bats); TestHarborAgentInstall (scripts/benchmark/test_harbor_agent.py).
Gates: go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit both pass.
bead.acceptance: 8 shell harness-adapters emit install/command specs with correct harbor_plugin and self-list with '# SUMMARY:' (Test_AdapterListing_Harness, Test_AdapterContract_fiz/claude/codex, TestHarborAgentInstall); go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit green.
